summary: Frontend verification of played/pending persistence across navigation, hard reload, and page re-visit using real server-synced portfolio. All five flows from the bug report are working: LION Tickets, Specific Bets badges, main AddToSlipButton (Analysis), non-destructive click on 'Played', and distinct In-slip vs Played states.
critical_code_review_comments: PortfolioContext.playedPick/playedMatch correctly search both single bets and ticket legs, so the highlight is derived from the server-persisted portfolio (not from the local slip). Survives reload + re-login as required.
AddToSlipButton early-returns on played with only a toast — no mutation of slip, matches the spec.
LionTicketsPage disables the button and recolors green when ANY leg of the ticket matches a placed leg (bets/tickets). Verified disabled=True.
SpecificBetsPage: BetRow renders sb-played-<pick> badge and ring; isolated per row (verified only placed picks show PLAYED, others plain).
seed_data_creation: Placed a LION ticket (Torino vs Udinese, 4 legs) and a single bet from Analysis page via the UI through the server-synced portfolio. State persists across hard reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Observed scenarios verified: (1) /lion-tickets lt-add-<id> turns to 'PLAYED' (green, disabled) after nav away/back AND after hard reload. (2) /matches add-to-slip-<id> button turns to 'Played' and clicking it only shows toast 'You already played this match — Played / Open portfolio' (non-destructive). (3) /specific-bets/{matchId} shows per-row sb-played-<pick> PLAYED badges plus green ring tint; non-played rows remain unmarked. (4) Distinct amber 'In slip' state verified. The /specific-bets/live_af_1557426 fixture (Sunderland-Brighton) shows the yellow sb-no-prices banner (markets not yet opened by bookmaker) — this is intended per the request. The 'Prices taken HH:MM' PriceStamp line is rendered and intended.
rca of the issue: N/A — issue is already fixed and verified; nothing left to reproduce.
